reviews.text: It was a normal night. After a long day, I was ready relax playing games for a bit and go to bed. The next thing I knew was that the Sun was rising. My fingers were cramped from ramming on the mouse countless times and my eyes were throbbing, bloodshot from staring at the screen too long. But it was an enjoyable time. Definitely recommend this game, It's rather simple, addictive style is definitely a go for those who enjoyed playing Vampire Survivor style games. It's also free, making it even better.

Bone To Gather stands out in the crowded rogue-like genre with its unique gameplay mechanics and charmingly macabre aesthetic. Whether you’re a seasoned fan of rogue-likes or a newcomer looking for a quick yet satisfying experience, this game is a must-try. A Unique Twist on Gameplay The game’s core mechanic centers around mouse-click controls that guide both your player and an army of skeletons. As you progress, you’ll collect bones scattered across the battlefield to summon additional skeletons. The twist? These skeletons hail from wildly varied backgrounds—a popstar from the slums, a clown from a pirate crew, and even a cleaner from a magic academy. This diversity isn’t just cosmetic; it plays directly into the game’s synergy-building mechanics. Placing skeletons with similar roles or backgrounds together unlocks powerful effects, adding a strategic layer to the fast-paced action. Replayability at Its Best Bone To Gather nails the delicate balance of variety and replayability. The hundreds of possible skeleton combinations and synergy effects mean no two runs feel the same. Whether you’re testing out new team builds or exploring different strategies, the game keeps you coming back for more. High Stakes and Fast Action In Bone To Gather, your skeletons are as fragile as they are formidable. A single hit shatters them into bones, forcing you to scramble across the battlefield to collect their remains before your entire team collapses. This creates a thrilling dynamic where you’re constantly on edge, balancing offense, defense, and resource management. Aesthetic and Audio Excellence The game’s visual style perfectly complements its quirky yet dark theme. From the detailed skeleton designs to the battlefield environments, the aesthetic feels cohesive and intentional. The music also deserves a shoutout; it’s a perfect match for the game’s tone, enhancing the experience without overshadowing the gameplay. A Gift to Gamers Perhaps the best part? Bone To Gather is entirely free. It’s rare to find a game of this quality offered at no cost, making it an easy recommendation for anyone curious about the genre or looking for a fun distraction. Final Thoughts Bone To Gather is more than just another rogue-like. It’s a testament to how creative mechanics, polished gameplay, and thoughtful design can come together to create something truly special. Whether you’re in it for the strategy, the action, or just the sheer joy of building an army of eccentric skeletons, this game delivers on all fronts. And did we mention it’s free? There’s no reason not to dive into this bone-gathering adventure today! [quote]Thank you for reading my review. I am a 55 year old biker and trucker father, and probably one of the oldest people playing this game. I am a single father to my Son, who is 15 now. My son got this game for from his uncle, so we installed it on his computer and he started playing. By the end of the week he had 12 hours on this game. This was horrible for me, as it was already hard for me to find ways to spend time with my son, as he is always out with his friends or just watching YouTube. So i decided to make a Steam account and get this game to see if I could maybe play alongside him. I loaded into the game and started playing but I was stuck on what you where supposed to do. I asked my Son for help and he let me borrow his controller. Me and my son then played in turns and I loved it as it was the best time I had spent with my Son since my wife had died. This game has ever since brought me and my son closer again and now we actually spend time together outside the house together as well. This game reminded me that there's fun to be had in everything, and it has brought both me and my son many happy memories.

非常棒的小游戏，考虑到它是免费的，那就是没有缺点了。 音乐欢快，打击节奏随心而动，是一款不可多得的小甜品游戏，心情低落来一把，看着里面的小骷髅奋起冲杀，感觉都被治愈了。 本人300h时长以下的游戏一般是懒得写评测的，但是遇到可心的游戏，也不会吝啬推荐。

好玩，单机自走棋，还免费，还要啥自行车 游戏小知识(1.3版本) 1.聚光灯要骷髅停止移动聚光灯才会移动 2.金币100上限,小偷可以在那个产老鼠BOSS那里刷钱 3.骷髅多少买多卖，过关后银卡以上可以拿不亏 4.3个羁绊海盗宝藏是3块钱，5个羁绊是5块钱，拿了海盗宝物5个羁绊是10块钱 5.游戏6关后的死了重试功能,小偷偷的钱重试后也会保留 6.不小心死了可以用ALT+F4关闭游戏，来读档，点下一阶段才会保存 7.游戏商店的宝物可以利用上面的读档来刷新 8.音乐，歌手，五星等成就可以小偷海盗开局，有钱这些都不是问题 9.近战的攻击方式拼命的对着怪点移动(小心aoe，能一下给你整团灭) 说下成就 500伤害我是格雷丝为主，7小偷3英雄9格子，格雷丝3星，宝物吉他75% 引擎10% 猪存钱罐，海盗宝藏，自行车(最后没用上)。开局海盗小偷打钱，然后先看宝物，要保留30留买宝物，剩下再开格子，(到boss关只剩29金币)到boss关英雄翻倍成就就弹出来了

8.5/10 A cute and fun roguelike. Provides satisfying variations in strategy, moderately tricky combat, and quick & snappy gameplay. Completionists get the satisfaction of filling out the collection page by beating the 36 stages with each kind of skeleton. Achievement hunters will find a simple and fun set of challenges.
